notes: μέν is unrepresented: the ASV writes no word for it, and marking the correlation elsewhere is not writing it (rule 70). A reference comparison will report this as a disagreement, and that report is not a correction.
περί → as concerning is a two-word preposition carrying no lexical noun, so the head stands on the prepositional word.
ἀντιλέγεται keeps the preverb's against inside its own unit, headed on the verb word spoken (rule 106).
